en: A black‑and‑white postcard shows a large villa or guesthouse in a rural, hilly landscape. The building has two stories with dormer windows and a long glazed veranda on the right side. The word "Germaniabaude" is prominently written on the veranda. In the foreground there is an open field; to the right, trees line a path or road. Low forested hills rise in the misty background. Printed caption text appears at the bottom margin.
